# GHOSTLINE and FIELDNOTE: how they differ

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/gen-differences.mjs --write` from each app's src/model.ts. Do not edit by hand; CI runs --check. -->

Both apps use only the public WEAVE API. They differ in their workflows and in the merge rule each
field declares. Each row names the demo step (`npm run demo:<app>`, lines marked `[step <id>]`)
whose output shows that rule at work.

## Merge rules in use

| Merge rule | GHOSTLINE | FIELDNOTE |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `last-writer-wins` (last writer wins) | `announcements.title`, `announcements.body`, `announcements.author`, `requests.title`, `requests.details`, `requests.claimedBy` | `inspections.title`, `inspections.location`, `inspections.site`, `inspections.zone`, `observations.inspectionId`, `observations.note`, `observations.reading` |
| `max` (highest value wins) | not used | `observations.severity` |
| `min` (lowest value wins) | not used | not used |
| `set-union` (union, nothing lost) | `requests.tags` | `inspections.assignees` |
| `max-rank` (most advanced value wins) | `announcements.status`, `requests.state` | `inspections.status` |

## GHOSTLINE

Workflow: publish and claim: announcements and help requests.

| Collection | Field | Merge rule | Demo step |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `announcements` v1 | `title` | last-writer-wins | `offline` |
| `announcements` v1 | `body` | last-writer-wins | `concurrent` |
| `announcements` v1 | `status` | max-rank: draft < published | `result` |
| `announcements` v1 | `author` | last-writer-wins | `offline` |
| `requests` v1 | `title` | last-writer-wins | `offline` |
| `requests` v1 | `details` | last-writer-wins | `offline` |
| `requests` v1 | `tags` | set-union | `result` |
| `requests` v1 | `claimedBy` | last-writer-wins | `notices` |
| `requests` v1 | `state` | max-rank: open < fulfilled | `replay` |

## FIELDNOTE

Workflow: structured record review: inspections and observations.

| `inspections` v2 | `zone` | last-writer-wins | `result` |

| `inspections` v2 | `assignees` | set-union | `result` |
| `observations` v1 | `inspectionId` | last-writer-wins | `v1-work` |
